• Tech stocks, particularly in the AI sector, are reviving interest, leading to a 3% gain in the Nasdaq 100.
• Price is currently situated in the equilibrium zone of its working range, reflecting potential consolidation as market participants assess the implications of earnings and macroeconomic data.
